Q1: Which branch should the fix target?
Choices:
A. PR #6951's head branch `claude/elegant-mendel-5pli2i-claude-pool-health-alert`. The plan records it as the target branch, so the fix PR stacks on it and merges into it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The default branch (`main`). This only works after PR #6951 merges. Before that, the change breaks the inventory and contract checks on `main`.
C. No pipeline fix. Close this issue and let the PR #6951 author push the two-line fix to the PR branch directly.
Q2: If the PR #6951 branch already passes these two checks when planning starts (for example, the author fixed them after the triage run), what should happen?
Choices:
A. Make no changes and close this issue as already fixed, after confirming that `docs/INVENTORY.md` lists the script and the `orchestrate_poll.yml` count matches the workflow. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Edit the files anyway to match the triage diagnosis.
